notes.title: Yeah... it took a while, but it's finally on the way!
notes.notes:
Yes, the legend is real: [b]Ultimate Truco is alive and kicking[/b]  and it’s finally entered the load testing phase! After disappearing for a while (shoutout to everyone who kept asking and still believed!), now it’s the real deal. 😅

It’s been 5 years of hard work. Yep, FIVE. If we had started a college degree, we’d be graduating by now. But honestly, every bit of the game was crafted with care, aiming to make something genuinely fun to play and something you’d be proud to yell “TRUCOOO!” in.

We know a lot of people got [b]pretty pissed[/b] about the delay. And fair enough. But we’d rather take our time and deliver something solid than rush and release a half-baked mess.

Right now we’re stress testing the servers with automated matches,  basically bots playing non-stop to see how much the system can handle. If all goes well, next stop is launch. 👀

[previewyoutube=DffkVxARpe8;full][/previewyoutube]

🛠️ Here’s what’s going down right now:

[list] [*] Server stress tests (in the good way)

[*] Match tuning and balance adjustments

[*] Bug fixes (and yes, some new ones show up too — but we’ll squash those too 😅)

[*] Listening to community feedback (you’ll be involved in everything) [/list]

We’re forever grateful for your patience, the memes, the messages, and even the rage quits. You all kept this project alive.

Stay tuned , more updates are coming soon. We’re almost there!

Let’s goooo, legends! 💥

Sincerely,
The Ultimate Truco Team

notes.title: A brief news to all
notes.notes:
Hello everyone ! I've been bringing news to everyone ...

[b] - Recently, Steam disapproved the construction of our game because some features are missing, in this case, our team decided to complete 70% of the project before publishing for release on Steam ...

There it will take some time until everything is in compliance, we will make available a page on [i] PATREON [/ i] to those who are interested in sponsoring the project and versions will also be available to play in advance. [/b]

For those who are interested, here is the link to sponsor the project: [url=https://www.patreon.com/ultimatetruco?fan_landing=true]ULTIMATE TRUCO PATREON[/url]

Thank you all for your patience, don't worry if you can't sponsor for now, the game will soon be available ːsteamhappyː
